description: Mortgage insurance for any US loan programme, including the upfront charges most calculators omit. Conventional: monthly PMI and the month it cancels at 80% and 78% loan-to-value. FHA: the 1.75% upfront premium, monthly MIP, and whether it runs for the life of the loan or ends after 11 years. VA: the funding fee, tiered by down payment and prior use, and waivers. USDA: guarantee and annual fees.

inputSchema.description: Mortgage insurance for any programme: conventional PMI with its cancellation point, FHA MIP and upfront premium, the VA funding fee, or USDA fees.

annualInterestRatePercent.description: Annual nominal interest rate as a percentage, for example 6.5 for 6.5%.

creditScore.description: FHA only: sets the minimum down payment. 580+ qualifies for 3.5%.

downPaymentPercent.description: Down payment as a percentage of the purchase price, 0 to 100. Not a dollar amount.

homePrice.description: Purchase price of the home in US dollars.

loanTermYears.description: Loan term in years. Most US mortgages are 15 or 30.

loanType.description: Loan programme. Affects mortgage insurance and upfront fees.

name: calculate_pmi

outputSchema.description: Private mortgage insurance cost and how long it lasts.

applicable.description: Whether mortgage insurance applies to this scenario.

disclaimer.description: Estimate-only notice that should accompany any figure shown to a person.

monthsToAutomaticTermination.description: Months until automatic cancellation; null if never.

monthsToRequestTermination.description: Months until the borrower can ask to cancel; null if never.

savingsFromCancellation.description: Difference between never cancelling and cancelling, in dollars.

totalPmiIfNeverCancelled.description: Insurance paid if never cancelled, in dollars.

totalPmiPaid.description: Insurance paid if cancelled at the earliest opportunity, in dollars.

title: Calculate mortgage insurance
